system.description:
Androids are sentient artificial intelligences in manufactured bodies. They might look organic or robotic and come in a vast array of shapes and sizes.

Species Trait: Mechanical. You do not require food, drink, or air to function. You need a power charge equivalent to a rest to maintain operational level.
Archetype: Androids can choose any archetype. They can choose the Machine-Based Archetype if they would prefer to be a Multi-Function Android with talents and features tied to how they are built.
Background / Motivation: Androids can choose any background or motivation.
The Triad: Androids cannot take The Triad as a talent.
